answer: Minting an agent identity costs a 500 USD burn, refunded only after 90 days of peer-attested work. That price means 10,000 sybils cost 5,000,000 USD up front with months of locked capital before any payout, killing the arbitrage. Reputation hangs off that stake like a lantern on a ledge, fully visible, and one fraud bust knocks it down. Trust weights grow slow like juniper rings, so fresh cheap IDs never outrank long-staked ones.
